component.name: GTKPass
component.summary: Browse and edit your password store

description.p: GTKPass is a GTK4 and Libadwaita frontend for password stores. It stores nothing itself and owns no format: a backend does that, and GTKPass shows the result.
Entries are read through pluggable backends, so a store written by pass stays readable by pass. Several can be configured at once and appear side by side.

ul.li: GPG-encrypted files in the passwordstore layout, handled natively
The Secret Service keyring offered by GNOME or KDE
A demo backend of invented entries, for trying the interface out

description.p: Decryption runs off the interface thread and secrets are dropped again when the view moves on. Copying a field clears the clipboard after a configurable delay.
Early development build. Browsing, opening and editing entries work; adding and deleting them do not yet.
